## Forking and compaction

- **Fix forking from a message opening an unrelated conversation.** Row-level forks and the pivot menu now resolve the recipient session entry against the newest matching file entries at click time, and the provisional Pi process no longer inherits a stale `--continue`/`--resume` session when a session file is forced.
- **Compacted-context card.** After compaction, PiTTy shows a bordered card with the context size change (`152K → ~32K`), the reason (`threshold`/`overflow`/`manual`), how long the compaction took, and an expandable Markdown summary of what Pi kept.

## Timing metrics

- The Timing section's tool number is now the **median of (turn time ÷ tool calls in that turn)** — it reflects what each tool round-trip costs inside a turn instead of the raw wall time of the tool process.
- **Turn time includes TTFT** (prompt processing → first token → generation), counted exactly once.
- Tool call counts are preserved even when individual per-call timings are incomplete.
- The **model picker now shows Turn/Tool medians for every model** in the list that has run requests this session.

Full suite: 422 tests — 421 pass, 1 skip.
